title: Knowledge-Guided Local-to-Global Anomaly Learning for Longitudinal Medication Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.19106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting suspicious deviations in longitudinal medication trajectories requires distinguishing knowledge-consistent treatment variations from anomalous changes and linking local deviations to account-level decisions. We propose a knowledge-guided local-to-global (L2G) anomaly learning framework that addresses both challenges. It constructs proxy supervision at three granularities: medication occurrences, treatment episodes, and contiguous visit segments. Knowledge-consistent medication and episode replacements provide plausible negatives, while cross-category and cross-account perturbations provide suspicious proxies. A medication-multiset encoder and causal visit-sequence encoder feed a shared scoring head that produces visit-level anomaly logits. translated_title: 知识引导的纵向用药轨迹局部到全局异常学习
translated_abstract: 检测纵向用药轨迹中的可疑偏差，需要区分符合知识的治疗变化与异常变化，并将局部偏差与账户级决策联系起来。我们提出了一种知识引导的局部到全局（L2G）异常学习框架，以同时应对这两项挑战。该框架在三个粒度上构建代理监督：用药事件、治疗疗程以及连续的就诊片段。符合知识的药物与疗程替换提供了合理的负样本，而跨类别和跨账户的扰动则提供了可疑的代理样本。药物多重集编码器与因果就诊序列编码器的输出共同输入到一个共享的评分头，生成就诊级别的异常logits。Top-α聚合从这些就诊级logits中推导出账户级分数，同时账户级分类任务与类别平衡的就诊定位任务共同优化同一就诊
tldr: 该论文提出一种知识引导的局部到全局（L2G）异常学习框架，通过在用药事件、治疗疗程和就诊片段三个粒度上构建代理监督，并利用Top-α聚合将就诊级异常检测与账户级分类联合优化，从而有效识别纵向用药轨迹中的可疑偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a knowledge-guided local-to-global (L2G) anomaly learning framework that constructs proxy supervision at three granularities (medication occurrences, treatment episodes, and visit segments) and jointly optimizes visit-level anomaly detection and account-level classification via Top-α aggregation to identify suspicious deviations in longitudinal medication trajectories.
